questions.questionText: Which concept did the ReactJS team introduce by extending the idea of reusing logic through functions to reusing views (HTML + CSS)?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Components.

questions.questionText: In the session's analogy, components are compared to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Lego blocks.

questions.questionText: How many types of components does ReactJS have as per the session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Two.

questions.questionText: Which are the two types of components in ReactJS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Functional and Class components.

questions.questionText: Which is one of the two conditions for a normal function to be treated as a functional component?
options: Its name must start with a capital letter
Its name must be all in lowercase
It must use the class keyword
questions.correctAnswer: Its name must start with a capital letter
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Its name must start with a capital letter.

questions.questionText: What must a functional component return?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A JavaScript XML (JSX) element.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a valid functional component name?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Welcome.

questions.questionText: Which is the correct way to use a component named Welcome inside the App component?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) <Welcome />.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a correct way to call a component named Hello?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Both <Hello /> and <Hello></Hello>.

questions.questionText: What is the main benefit of rendering <Welcome /> three times in App?
options: It increases the bundle size only
It converts class components to functions
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) It demonstrates component reusability.

questions.questionText: Which class must a class component extend in ReactJS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) React.Component.

questions.questionText: Which special method of a class component displays the view on the screen?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) render().

questions.questionText: Which statement about class components is correct?
options: They are written as plain functions
They are not supported in ReactJS
They serve the same purpose as functional components
questions.correctAnswer: They serve the same purpose as functional components
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) They serve the same purpose as functional components.

questions.questionText: In which ReactJS version were functional components (with hooks) introduced, shifting the ecosystem from class to function?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 16.8.

questions.questionText: Which event accelerated the movement of the ReactJS ecosystem from class to functional components?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Introduction of hooks.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a drawback of class components?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Larger boilerplate code.

questions.questionText: Which JavaScript concept typically requires in-depth mastery when using class components?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The this keyword.

questions.questionText: According to the session, how much less code can the functional version need compared to the equivalent class component?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) About 40%.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of functional components?
options: No need for in-depth knowledge of concepts like this
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Lots of boilerplate code.

questions.questionText: Currently, in companies, which type of component is generally used?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Only functional components.

questions.questionText: In ReactJS, data flows:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Only from parent to child.

questions.questionText: The data passed from a parent component to a child component is called:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Props or properties.

questions.questionText: Props data flow is bidirectional. This statement is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) False.

questions.questionText: Which of the following correctly receives props in a functional component?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) function Welcome(props) { ... }.

questions.questionText:
Given function Welcome(props) { return

Hello, {props.name}

; }, how is name passed from the parent?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) <Welcome name="Neo" />.

questions.questionText: What is the ES6 feature used to shorten props access as function Welcome({ name })?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Destructuring.

questions.questionText: In function Welcome({ name }), what does { name } do?
options: Extracts the name key out of the props object
questions.correctAnswer: Extracts the name key out of the props object
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Extracts the name key out of the props object.

questions.questionText: Which statement about passing data from child to parent is correct as per the session?
options: There is no direct way; hooks are a workaround
There is a direct built-in way using props
It is done automatically by the Virtual DOM
questions.correctAnswer: There is no direct way; hooks are a workaround
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) There is no direct way; hooks are a workaround.

questions.questionText: Passing data from child to parent is especially useful when:
options: The parent must be informed about changes in the child component
questions.correctAnswer: The parent must be informed about changes in the child component
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The parent must be informed about changes in the child component.

questions.questionText: What does HOC stand for in ReactJS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Higher-Order Component.

questions.questionText: What do Higher-Order Components (HOC) do?
options: Wrap components to make it easier to pass logic to them
questions.correctAnswer: Wrap components to make it easier to pass logic to them
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Wrap components to make it easier to pass logic to them.

questions.questionText: A HOC acts like a:
options: Template component for building new components
questions.correctAnswer: Template component for building new components
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Template component for building new components.

questions.questionText: HOCs are especially useful in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Theming and customizing a component.

questions.questionText: In the session's example, which function is the HOC?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) withStyles.

questions.questionText: In the session's example, what is StyledText?
options: A new component created by wrapping the existing Text component using withStyles
A class component that extends Text
questions.correctAnswer: A new component created by wrapping the existing Text component using withStyles
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A new component created by wrapping the existing Text component using withStyles.

questions.questionText: Which statement about the HOC example output is correct?
options: <Text /> contains its own style, while <StyledText /> contains the HOC style
Both components always have identical style
questions.correctAnswer: <Text /> contains its own style, while <StyledText /> contains the HOC style
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) <Text /> contains its own style, while <StyledText /> contains the HOC style.

questions.questionText: What does a HOC such as withStyles(Component) return?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A new component.

questions.questionText: Which of the following correctly describes the relationship between a component and the final UI?
options: The UI must be a single component
Each part of the UI can be a combination of multiple components bundled together
questions.correctAnswer: Each part of the UI can be a combination of multiple components bundled together
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Each part of the UI can be a combination of multiple components bundled together.

questions.questionText: Which type of component was ReactJS originally based on?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Class components.

questions.questionText: What is the base class that serves for creating a class component called?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) React.Component.

questions.questionText: In the session, component reusability is shown by:
options: Copying the same code multiple times
Calling the same Welcome component multiple times in App
questions.correctAnswer: Calling the same Welcome component multiple times in App
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Calling the same Welcome component multiple times in App.

questions.questionText: Where is the component file in the session's examples written?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) App.js.

questions.questionText: A component name beginning with a lowercase letter will be treated by React as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) An HTML tag.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to export a component so it can be imported elsewhere?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) export.

questions.questionText: Which is the correct way to nest the Welcome component inside App's JSX return?
questions.explanation:
Correct answer is D) return
;.

questions.questionText: Which of the following describes "props" best?
options: Read-only data passed from parent to child
Private data a component creates and manages
questions.correctAnswer: Read-only data passed from parent to child
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Read-only data passed from parent to child.

questions.questionText: In which direction does a function passed as a prop allow communication?
options: From child to parent by calling the parent's function
questions.correctAnswer: From child to parent by calling the parent's function
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) From child to parent by calling the parent's function.

questions.questionText: Which is the primary drawback listed for class components that led to lesser usage?
options: Larger boilerplate code and need to master this
questions.correctAnswer: Larger boilerplate code and need to master this
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Larger boilerplate code and need to master this.
